title: “It Feels Like Being Locked in A Cage”: Understanding Blind or Low Vision Streamers’ Perceptions of Content Curation Algorithms
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative human-computer interaction (HCI) study that examines how blind or low-vision streamers perceive and interact with recommendation algorithms on live-streaming platforms. It does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethical frameworks.
